items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I did "Fever" with Little Willie John

ctx.x: And also, I did "Fever" with Little Willie John, where later on, the tune was recorded by Peggy Lee and became a big classic. I did, "Drown in My Own Tears"

"Hallelujah, with Ray Charles, and "Hallelujah, I Love Her So" with Ray Charles and "Maryann". I also did the only million selling record that Sarah Vaughn ever had, I was playing drums on, called "Haunting Melody". I was playing drums on that.
